candidate_scope: The owner-provided canonical light and dark route-map/bottom-sheet boards remain byte-for-byte in MarshGO-Site. This candidate pins Server 2dc360531c5a3961a0a789322394d9416a192b48, Site 186ee4b0095869be357674fc1a324450204e144f, and iOS ad0ba2e2d35d444407b4fd6ab9e1656b1ab67ecf. The Server routes GTFS schedules with transfer/pathway feasibility, fare evidence, TripUpdates and verified vehicle markers; its optional WALKING_ROUTING_URL foot-profile adapter replaces unmodeled straight-line walks with routed distance/time and geometry, rechecking transfer windows. Foot-provider work is bounded to 1.5 seconds per request, 12 concurrent/24 queued per process and 32 new routes per search. Without that provider, walks stay marked as estimates and strict constraints reject unverified paths. Search still returns direct Community offers separately from GTFS itineraries: it does not yet compose a Community ride with public transit or provide commercial taxi/car-share/bike routes or automatic disruption re-planning. Current public GTFS feeds do not provide fares. Production remains NOT_RELEASED; national provider coverage, authoritative fares, production infrastructure and load/field acceptance are incomplete.
